outcome: Transfer of valproate and lamotrigine across late gestation placenta
Entry into brain of developing rats
cohort: The participants were Genetic Absence Epilepsy Rats from Strasbourg (GAERS) at embryonic day (E) 19, postnatal day (P) 0, 4 and 21, and adults.
finding: Combination therapy of valproate and lamotrigine decreased placental transfer of valproate but increased foetal brain entry of valproate following chronic exposure, while enhancing lamotrigine entry into the adult brain without affecting valproate's entry into brain and CSF.
followup_time: Postnatal day 21 (for developing rats) and adulthood
